headline: SBC Exports files AGM scrutiny report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: SBC Exports Limited has submitted its scrutinizer's report and voting results for the Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing completes the mandatory compliance process following the shareholder meeting. For retail investors, this is a routine administrative disclosure with no immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price.
